issue.description: The 'main' function uses 'raise RuntimeError' to simulate an exit(0) success, which is non-standard and confusing for callers.
issue.suggestion: Use 'sys.exit(0)' only in the 'main' entry point, not in library functions, and remove the 'raise RuntimeError' for success cases.

issue.description: Module-level os.environ.get() calls constitute module-level side effects (I/O). Violates v11.7 'No module-level side effects'.
issue.suggestion: Move ARCHIVE_BASE and CMR_MOUNT resolution into functions or a config class initialized at runtime.

issue.description: Hardcoded 'psql' and 'zstd' commands assume availability in PATH. No version checks or fallback.
issue.suggestion: Use shutil.which() to verify commands exist at startup; make commands configurable via env vars.

issue.description: archive_partition function does too much: creates dirs, runs subprocess, drops table. Hard to test and reuse.
issue.suggestion: Split into: create_archive_dir(), export_partition_to_jsonl(), compress_file(), drop_partition().

issue.description: Module-level mutable global 'calls' list violates v11.7 'No module-level side effects' rule
issue.suggestion: Move calls list inside run_verification function or encapsulate in a verification context class

issue.description: fake_encode function defined at module level with dependency on global 'calls' list; pollutes production namespace despite being test-only utility
issue.suggestion: Move fake_encode inside run_verification as a local function, or create a test-specific module. For CI tool, define it locally within the verification function

issue.description: Worker function mutates shared `results` list via side effect instead of returning value. Makes testing harder and obscures data flow.
issue.suggestion: Return the index from worker and collect via `future.result()`: `results = [f.result() for f in futures]`.

issue.description: calculate_entropy creates collections.Counter and log2_table for every call; for large tokens or many tokens this allocates O(n) memory and O(n) time per token
issue.suggestion: Cache log2_table per token length using functools.lru_cache; consider streaming entropy calculation for very long tokens; avoid Counter for single-pass frequency counting

issue.description: is_allowlisted iterates through all compiled regex patterns for every token; O(patterns * tokens) complexity; patterns could be combined into single alternation regex
issue.suggestion: Combine ALLOWLIST_PATTERNS into single regex: re.compile('|'.join(f'(?:{p})' for p in ALLOWLIST_PATTERNS)); use single fullmatch call

issue.description: log2_table recreated for every calculate_entropy call; for repeated token lengths this is redundant computation
issue.suggestion: Add @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128) to a helper _make_log2_table(length) function; or cache table in module-level dict keyed by length

issue.description: _check_batch_quota fetches quota/cost for providers_needed but then iterates all providers_in_batch again - redundant iteration and potential N+1 if called repeatedly without cache
issue.suggestion: Merge the two loops: after fetching, validate all providers_in_batch in single pass. Consider moving cache to module-level with TTL decorator instead of passing dicts around.

issue.description: _fetch_provider_values creates new cursor for each call when cursor=None - inefficient for repeated calls in loops
issue.suggestion: Callers should pass reusable cursor. Document this clearly. Consider making cursor mandatory and removing auto-create logic to force proper cursor management.

issue.description: sanitize function uses hardcoded sensitive_patterns list - not configurable, may miss organization-specific secret patterns
issue.suggestion: Make sensitive_patterns a parameter with default. Load from config file/env var for production deployments. Add regex support for high-entropy token detection.

issue.description: Imports psycopg2 at module level - hard dependency even if only SQLite is used in tests, violates dependency isolation
issue.suggestion: Move psycopg2 import inside get_db_connections or behind try/except with helpful error message. Allows testing with only sqlite3.

issue.description: Custom JsonFormatter duplicates functionality available in python-json-logger or structlog. Adds maintenance burden and potential bugs (e.g., missing standard fields).
issue.suggestion: Replace with: import pythonjsonlogger.jsonlogger.JsonFormatter or structlog. Configure via dictConfig. Remove custom class.
